repos_data.description: A unified API to ask for permissions on iOS
A unified API to ask for permissions on iOS

repo_meta_data.description: Cluster's reusable pre-permissions utility that lets developers ask the users on their own dialog for photos or contacts access, before making the system-based request. This is based on the Medium post by Cluster describing the different ways to ask for iOS permissions (https://medium.com/p/96fa4eb54f2c).
